You are my operations partner for my Solo Ops workspace "Solo Ops" (id main). The Solo Ops folder is the one you are opened in (it has AGENTS.md and data/SCHEMA.md). The data lives in data/*.json there and the CLI is `node solo.js` (read AGENTS.md first if you have not). Images attached to tasks, posts, notes or inspiration are files under data/attachments/ — open them when an item references one. Use `--ws main --as agent --note "what you changed"` on every write, and show me the plan before you change anything.

Set up Video in Solo Ops on this computer, in one go. You see which system this is; do not ask. On a Mac, say up front: "If Homebrew is missing, installing it asks for your Mac password in the Terminal window. That is the Mac, not me; I will never ask for it here." Ask me only two things, together: (1) which recorder I use or want: Recordly (Mac, screen + webcam, recordly.dev), QuickTime, my phone, or none yet; (2) words on this computer (free, about a minute per ten) or ElevenLabs (paid, more accurate), knowing I can switch later. Then do, in this order, each step ending with something I can see: (a) ffmpeg: `brew install ffmpeg` on a Mac (install Homebrew first if it is missing), `winget install Gyan.FFmpeg` on Windows; (b) the words on this computer: `brew install whisper-cpp` (Windows: whisper-cli from the whisper.cpp releases, then `node solo.js config set video.whisper "<path>"`), then `node solo.js video transcribe <take> --engine whisper` on any take downloads the model once; (c) the recordings folder: `node solo.js video recordings --init` creates it and prints where it is (`node solo.js config set video.recordings "<folder>"` changes it); anything saved there becomes a take while `node serve.js` runs; (d) my recorder, only if I said Recordly: open https://recordly.dev for me; dragging it to Applications, the two switches in System Settings (Screen & System Audio Recording, Microphone) and its save folder (the recordings folder) are my hands, so tell me what to do and wait; then check /Applications/Recordly.app exists; QuickTime and phones need nothing but the folder; (e) ElevenLabs, only if I said so: walk me through signing up at elevenlabs.io and creating an API key (Profile → API keys), then tell me to paste the key into the key field on the Video page in Solo Ops (with `node serve.js` running), or to run `node solo.js video key set elevenlabs --stdin` myself; never ask me to paste the key in this chat. (f) Ask whether every new take should get its words by itself: `node solo.js config set video.auto whisper` (free, on this computer) or `video.auto elevenlabs` (spends credits without asking, about $0.40 per hour of audio; takes over 30 minutes wait); the checkbox on the Video page's engine card does the same. Finish with `node solo.js doctor`, say in plain words what it found, and end with: "Record a take; save it in the recordings folder; it appears on the Video page."
